name: WindSun Science&Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: WindSun Science&Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of power electronic equipment and related products in China. The company offers high-voltage dynamic reactive power compensation devices; high, medium, and low voltage frequency converters; intelligent energy storage systems; rail transit energy feedback devices; explosion-proof and intelligent control equipment for coal mines; regenerative braking energy absorption devices and related supporting products; and high and low voltage switchgears.
